releases.notes:
Now works on every 26.x version, and StandardSettings is built in.

**Downloads**
- `speedrunport-1.1.0+26.1.jar` for 26.1, 26.1.1 and 26.1.2
- `speedrunport-1.1.0+26.2.jar` for 26.2
- `speedrunport-1.1.0+26.3.jar` for 26.3

Only install the one for your version, and delete the old 1.0.0 jar first.

**New**
- StandardSettings: resets your options from `config/standardoptions.txt` every time you make a new world, same file format as the StandardSettings mod (`renderDistanceOnWorldJoin`, `fovOnWorldJoin`, `chunkborders`, `pieDirectory`, `autoF3Esc`...). Run `/standardsettings save` once to make the file from your current settings. Every new world gets a copy in its folder.
- 26.1 and 26.2 support. The borderless window works there too (those versions still use GLFW for the window).
- F3 and the alt + F3 graphs follow your GUI scale again like 1.16.1, instead of 26.3's separate debug GUI scale. The pie chart keeps its 1.16.1 size.

**Fixes**
- Borderless window sticks out 1px on an edge with no other monitor, so Ninjabrain Bot and other always-on-top windows stay on top
- Block tags are hidden from F3 unless you turn them on in F3 + F6

**Requirements**
- Fabric Loader 0.19.3+
- Fabric API for your version

Tested alongside Sodium 0.9.3-beta.1, Lithium and FerriteCore on 26.3.

mods.name: SpeedrunPort
mods.description: Speedrun quality-of-life for 26.3: the 1.16.1 F3 screen (classic text, Shift+F3 pie chart, Alt+F3 FPS/TPS graphs, F3 + F render distance, F3 + Q key list) and a clean borderless window on its own key.

releases.notes:
First release, for Minecraft 26.3.

**1.16.1 F3**
- The old two-column F3 layout, filled in with real 26.3 data
- Shift + F3 for the profiler pie chart, Alt + F3 for the FPS / TPS graphs, drawn like 1.16.1
- F3 + F (render distance) and F3 + Q (key list) are back, rebindable in Controls > Debug
- Lines from other mods (Sodium etc.) go at the bottom of the right column
- Block tags are hidden unless you turn them on in F3 + F6

**Borderless window**
- F12 toggles it (Controls > Miscellaneous)
- Covers your monitor without being real fullscreen, so Ninjabrain Bot and other always-on-top windows stay on top
- Doesn't bleed onto a second monitor, puts your old window back when you turn it off, and is remembered between launches

**Requirements**
- Minecraft 26.3
- Fabric Loader 0.19.3+
- Fabric API

Tested alongside Sodium 0.9.3-beta.1, Lithium and FerriteCore.
